verses.text: A psalm for reflection by Ethan the Ezrahite. I’ll sing of the LORD’s faithful love forever. I’ll tell every generation how faithful you are.
Here’s what I say: “Your love stands firm forever. You set the heavens in place, and your faithfulness is there.”
“I made a covenant with the one I chose. I swore to David my servant,
‘I’ll establish your descendants forever and keep your throne standing through every generation.’” Selah.
The heavens praise your wonders, LORD. The holy ones gathered there praise your faithfulness.
Who in the skies can compare to the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like him?
God fills the council of the holy ones with awe. Everyone around him fears him above all.
LORD God of Armies, who has power like yours? LORD, your faithfulness surrounds you.
You rule the raging sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them down.
You smashed Rahab and left it like one of the slain. With your mighty arm you scattered your enemies.
The heavens are yours. So is the earth. You laid the foundation of the world and everything in it.
You made north and south. Tabor and Hermon sing for joy at your name.
Your arm is mighty. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is lifted high.
Your throne rests on righteousness and justice. Faithful love and truth go ahead of you.
Blessed are the people who know how to shout your praise. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.
They rejoice in your name all day long. Your righteousness lifts them up.
You’re the glory behind their strength. Your favor lifts our horn high.
Our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king belongs to the Holy One of Israel.
Then you spoke to your faithful ones in a vision: “I’ve given strength to a warrior. I’ve raised up a young man from among the people.
I found David my servant and anointed him with my holy oil.
My hand will hold him steady. My arm will make him strong.
No enemy will squeeze tribute out of him. No wicked person will oppress him.
I’ll crush his enemies in front of him and strike down those who hate him.
My faithfulness and faithful love will stay with him, and in my name his horn will rise high.
I’ll set his hand over the sea and his right hand over the rivers.
He’ll call out to me, ‘You’re my Father, my God, and the rock that saves me!’
I’ll make him my firstborn, the highest of all the kings of the earth.
I’ll keep showing him faithful love forever. My covenant with him will stand firm.
I’ll make his descendants last forever and his throne last as long as heaven.
If his children abandon my instruction and stop living by my judgments,
if they break my laws and refuse to keep my commands,
I’ll punish their rebellion with the rod and their wrongdoing with blows.
But I won’t take my faithful love away from him or let my faithfulness fail.
I won’t break my covenant or change a word I’ve spoken.
I’ve sworn once by my holiness. I won’t lie to David.
His descendants will last forever. His throne will stand before me like the sun.
It’ll stand forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.
But you’ve turned away and rejected your anointed king. You’ve been angry with him.
You’ve renounced your covenant with your servant and dragged his crown through the dust.
You’ve broken down all his defenses and left his strongholds in ruins.
Everyone passing by takes what they want from him. His neighbors mock him.
You’ve lifted up the right hand of his foes and given all his enemies reason to celebrate.
You’ve turned back the edge of his sword and left him without support in battle.
You’ve put an end to his splendor and thrown his throne to the ground.
You’ve cut his youth short and covered him with shame. Selah.
How long, LORD? Will you hide forever? Will your anger keep burning like fire?
Remember how little time I have. How fleeting you’ve made every human life!
Who can live without seeing death? Who can pull their own life out of Sheol’s grip? Selah.
Lord, where is the faithful love you showed before, the love you swore to David in your faithfulness?
Remember the insults your servants have taken, Lord. I carry the taunts of so many powerful peoples in my heart.
Your enemies mock you, LORD. They mock every step your anointed one takes.
Blessed be the LORD forever. Amen and amen.
